name: WealthFlow
description: Review Node-scheduled deposits and deliver them through Wealthfolio's supported add-on host API.
author: WealthFlow

permissions.purpose: List active Wealthfolio accounts and sync their identifiers to the scheduler.
Check stable activity IDs and create deposits only after explicit user confirmation.
Connect to the separately running WealthFlow scheduler over an approved HTTPS host.
Store and use the WealthFlow scheduler bearer token without reading it back into add-on JavaScript.
